items.title: Renew Athens-Clarke occupation tax certificate
items.description: Occupation tax certificates are valid for the calendar year; renewal is due on or before April 1 and later applications carry a 10% penalty.

items.title: Obtain and renew Atlanta Business Occupational Tax Certificate
items.authority: City of Atlanta Office of Revenue
items.description: Businesses operating in Atlanta hold an occupational tax certificate, renewed annually through the city's online portal; certificates expire December 31.

items.title: Renew Augusta occupation tax certificate
items.description: Businesses operating in Augusta pay the annual occupation tax and receive a business tax certificate. The tax is payable January 1 of each year; if not paid within 30 days of the due date, a 10% penalty and interest of 1.5% per month apply.

items.title: Renew Columbus occupation tax certificate
items.authority: Columbus Consolidated Government Occupation Tax Section
items.description: Renewal runs January 1 through April 1 with a signed return, SAVE and E-Verify affidavits; unpaid tax carries a 10% penalty and 1.5% monthly interest.

items.title: Renew Sandy Springs business license
items.authority: City of Sandy Springs Revenue Department
items.description: Licenses expire December 31; the city allows a 90-day grace period to March 31, after which a 10% penalty and 1.5% monthly interest apply.

items.title: Renew Savannah business tax certificate
items.description: Business tax certificates expire December 31 and renew annually. The city's pages give March 1 for renewal (the 2026 form says March 31) and a January 31 payment date, so confirm on your renewal packet.
items.deadline: Certificates expire December 31; renewal packet date varies

items.title: Obtain the Macon-Bibb occupation tax certificate
items.description: Every business, trade, profession, and occupation operating in Macon-Bibb County must obtain an occupation tax certificate (business license) unless exempt; confirm the applicable classification and fee with the county before operating.

note: Macon city-specific licensing was confirmed from the cited official source.

items.title: Renew the South Fulton occupational tax certificate
items.authority: City of South Fulton Business License Office
items.description: Businesses operating in South Fulton must maintain an annual occupational tax certificate for the calendar year; renew by March 31, with penalties and interest beginning April 1.

note: South Fulton city-specific licensing was confirmed from the cited official source.

items.title: Renew the Roswell occupation tax certificate
items.description: Businesses must obtain an occupation tax certificate before opening; the certificate expires December 31 and the occupation tax is due March 15, with a 10% penalty after the deadline.

note: Roswell city-specific licensing was confirmed from the cited official source.

items.title: Obtain the Warner Robins occupational tax certificate
items.authority: City of Warner Robins Business License Office
items.description: Warner Robins requires an occupational tax certificate (business license) to conduct business in the city, including when sales tax is not collected; fees depend on employees or business type.

note: Warner Robins requires an occupational tax certificate (business license) to conduct business in the city, including when sales tax is not collected; fees depend on employees or business type.

items.title: Apply for or renew the Johns Creek business license
items.authority: City of Johns Creek Revenue Department
items.description: Johns Creek provides a city business license and occupational tax process through its business portal; apply for or renew the license before conducting business and complete any applicable zoning, health or professional requirements.

note: Johns Creek provides a city business license and occupational tax process through its business portal; apply for or renew the license before conducting business and complete any applicable zoning, health or professional requirements.

items.title: Obtain the Alpharetta occupational tax certificate
items.authority: City of Alpharetta Business License Office
items.description: All businesses operating within Alpharetta must possess a current occupational tax certificate (business license) on the first day of business; fees and application requirements depend on the business category.

note: All businesses operating within Alpharetta must possess a current occupational tax certificate (business license) on the first day of business; fees and application requirements depend on the business category.

items.authority: City of Marietta Business License Division
items.description: Every business operating within Marietta city limits must have a current city business license; most businesses complete a general application, and fees are based on annual gross receipts or employee count.
